system.description: As scholars of the fighting arts know, this popular children's toy began as a weapon used by certain tribes in the East, who used weights on cords to stun birds and small game, and weighted blades on cords to attack each other. Casting a yo-yo with sufficient force to inflict damage requires basic Martial Arts proficiency. Catching the bladed form without cutting off your own hand requires a little more. The first trait bar describes a bladed yo-yo; the second describes the blunt version.
